messages.text:
Yes, keep your old receipt. Receipt R-H238-0001 covers the first two planters (107.80 BRL). It stays valid, and those two units can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

The shop's records show the third planter was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). I've created a separate refund proposal for it of 53.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount). To confirm it, press the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't confirm it. A staff member then reviews it (refund-policy/v2/approval). You'll get a new receipt only after the refund is paid.
